systemFullName: Electronic Bullying Safety and Awareness System
description: Content manifest for the e B-SAFE website. The app loads every file listed under 'files' at startup. Edit a file directly, or use the school's local teacher workspace to prepare changes for the website maintainer.
notes: All content files must be valid JSON. The local workspace checks a file before the website maintainer publishes it.
Student survey and evaluation responses, plus learning progress, are stored only in the current browser and can be exported as separate JSON response files.
Do not put private student information, credentials, or real incident reports into these content files.
